name: axiomaticai
description: Hand engineering and science work to Lemma: start a conversation or find and read an earlier one, send files, wait for the run, read the answer, download results, and open it in the browser.

open_browser.title: Open conversations in the browser
open_browser.description: Open each new conversation in your browser as soon as a message is sent.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: The model a new conversation starts on when Claude names none. Lemma's default is the model it would use in the browser.

default_machine.title: Default machine
default_machine.description: The machine a new conversation runs on when Claude names none.

max_tool_output_chars.title: Tool output cap
max_tool_output_chars.description: The most characters a Lemma tool returns to Claude. A longer result is cut, and Claude can save the whole of it to a file instead.
